Closest recurrent precedent: Tan et al., [Improved Recurrent Neural Networks for Session-based Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/html/1606.08117) (2016), train GRUs on every session prefix with its next-item label, plus 25% embedding dropout interpreted as random click deletion, resampled each epoch. They use a fixed 19-step BPTT window. This establishes chronology-preserving deletion and variable-length training as prior art, but does not isolate contiguous old-prefix removal or compare its retained-length distribution against fixed recent-history truncation.

Adjacent evidence: [CL4SRec implementation in DuoRec](https://github.com/RuihongQiu/DuoRec/blob/master/recbole/model/sequential_recommender/cl4srec.py) retains floor(0.6L) consecutive items with uniformly sampled start; two distinct operators are sampled uniformly from crop/mask/reorder, giving crop probability 1/3 per view. Length-one sequences bypass augmentation. This is arbitrary-position contrastive cropping with a Transformer, rather than target-preserving suffix training. [TiCoSeRec](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/25540/25312) excludes crop/reorder for short histories; thresholds are searched over {4,8,12,16,20}. [Recency Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.02643) evaluates GRU4Rec, but samples targets preferentially near the end rather than dropping old prefixes.

No inspected source establishes an optimal suffix-drop probability, uniform/geometric retained-length distribution, or controlled GRU4Rec comparison against fixed recent-history truncation. Novelty should therefore remain narrow and provisional. An inexpensive experiment would compare unchanged training, fixed recent-K context, and stochastic suffix cropping with matched expected retained length, keeping targets and optimization budget fixed. A conservative proposed setting—not literature-validated—is crop probability 0.25, retained length uniform over ceil(L/2)…L, bypassing L≤4. Report short-history strata and compare full-context versus matched-truncation inference to expose context mismatch; deploy one selected GRU checkpoint.
